text.card: A red giant 7,289 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 2.87 solar masses and 18.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,024 K at its surface.
